description: This file defines the OpenIdServerDeploymentSource class, which is responsible for processing deployment steps related to OpenID server settings in OrchardCore. It gathers configuration settings asynchronously and adds them to the deployment plan.

classes.name: OpenIdServerDeploymentSource
classes.description: A deployment source class for exporting OpenID server configuration settings during deployment.

methods.name: OpenIdServerDeploymentSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the deployment source with the OpenId server service.

methods.name: ProcessAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the deployment step by retrieving settings and adding them to the deployment result.
